# Tests

**Graded tests go here, written by hand by team members.** Tests generated by Claude or Codex score
zero, so they are not claimed as ours.

The files named `test_sample_*.py` were **written by Claude as patterns** (layout borrowed from Team 04's
AgentSwitch_4) and are **not** claimed as hand-written tests. Copy their shape into new files with your
own cases; do not rename them.

```bash
uv run pytest                 # everything
uv run pytest -m "not live"   # offline only: no token, no network
uv run pytest -m live         # live reads (needs `uv run python -m seat8 login --biz in`)
```

The four sample files show the four kinds of test worth writing:

| file | kind | needs |
|---|---|---|
| `test_sample_offline.py` | pure functions: coupon resolution, claim checks, error-code parsing, prose check | nothing |
| `test_sample_fakes.py` | a `FakeMCP` stands in for the platform: pagination, re-read, finding exactly once, failed escalation | nothing |
| `test_sample_harness.py` | the scorer and verifiers on hand-built contexts: wrong-run finding, dry-run write, drift | nothing |
| `test_sample_live.py` | read-only checks against Suryodaya, one client per module | a cached token |

Good building blocks: `seat8.storefront` (`classify_order`, `resolve_coupon`, `coupon_metrics`,
`order_check`, `reread_orders` with a fake client), `seat8.finding` (`validate`, `FindingRecorder`),
`seat8.agent` (`keyword_parse`, `verify_prose`, `render_template`, `escalate`), `seat8.llm.to_gemini_schema`,
`harness.score.generic_checks` and every `check` in `harness/verifiers/t08.py`.
